Name: Realistic Fireplaces
Author: jumb0t
Description:
[center]
[b]Realistic Fireplaces, a mod for Stardew Valley 1.6.
[/b]
Makes fireplaces burn out to embers when left unattended for longer than 3 hours (or left overnight). 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Kpdcrs68/demo.png[/img][/center]

[u]Requires
[/u]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[/list]
[u]Mod Compatability[/u]

[list]
[*]Compatible with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11846]brullov's fire animation[/url] [/b]![/*]
[*]Will work with all other Content Patcher mods (probably)[/*]
[*]This mod uses Harmony. While I've tried to make code patches as unobtrusive as possible, it may be the case that this mod conflicts with other Harmony-based mods. [/*]
[*]If you find incompatible mods, please leave a comment.[/*]
[/list]
[u]Source code

[/u][url=https://github.com/jthistle/realistic-fireplaces]Download the source on Github[/url].

[u]Acknowledgements
[/u]
[list]
[*]Thanks to inkpenrat for the ember sprites. Go [url=https://www.tumblr.com/ink-pen-rat]follow on Tumblr[/url]﻿﻿ or [url=https://ko-fi.com/inkpenrat]donate a coffee[/url]﻿.[/*]
[*]Thanks to everyone in the modding channel at the Stardew Valley Discord server for their help with light sources[/*]
[/list]
